logic.entry: Use completed UTC daily closes. Seed avgGain/avgLoss atdatasetindex2 with simplemeans of first2changes. Eachlaterday avg=(previousavg+newgain_or_loss)/2. RSI2=100*avgGain/(avgGain+avgLoss);bothzero50. Exact Fraction from encodedFloat64decimalstrings;no rounding or OOS/fold reset. Slow SMA uses lastTcompleted closes includingj;fast exit SMA uses last5completed closes. Compare price*Twith slow sum andprice*5with fast sum,without rounded means. Decimal60display,canonical RSIratioSHA;accountingDecimal28 unchanged. While flat,enter iff RSI2<entry_rsi_threshold AND close>SMA(trend_sma_days),bothstrict,no prior-cross requirement.
logic.exit: While long,exit iff close>SMA5 OR close<SMA(trend_sma_days),bothstrict;equality alone preserves long. No RSI exit,future padding,fold reset,short,hold cap or same-decision re-entry. Costed terminal liquidation.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.
logic.timing: Close-based signal only from a closed UTC daily bar, next day 00:01 UTC one-minute open (60-second delay); no historical fill before OOS.
